@s1 stated
  relation "have a power cut"
  role subject "the user"
  role time "this morning"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "give classes in"
  role subject "Georgiana"
  role object "mathematics"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "live in"
  role subject "Andreea Căpraru"
  role location "Szeged"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "live in"
  role subject "Tudor"
  role location "Lisbon"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@s5 stated
  relation "sell"
  role subject "Greenline Transport"
  role object "winter tyres"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s6 stated
  relation "sell"
  role subject "Brightfield Foods"
  role object "LED bulbs"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s7 stated
  relation "carry"
  role subject "Atelier Anghel"
  role object "garden furniture"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s8 stated
  relation "carry"
  role subject "Orion Robotics"
  role object "phone cases"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@s9 stated
  relation "publish"
  role subject "Timișoara Logistics"
  role object "Soups of Transylvania"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s10 stated
  relation "publish"
  role subject "Ardeleanu & Partners"
  role object "A Short History of Bridges"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s11 stated
  relation "be a supplier of"
  role subject "Farkas & Partners"
  role object "Tisa Textiles"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s12 stated
  relation "carry"
  role subject "Pitești Logistics"
  role object "baby food"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  select ?l
  where match
    relation "be based in"
    role subject "Chloé"
    role location ?l
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "treat"
    role subject "Ildikó"
    role object ?x
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q3 query
  where match
    relation "carry"
    role subject "Vertex Analytics"
    role object "sourdough bread"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q4 query
  select ?x
  where all
    match
      relation "intend to attend"
      role subject ?x
      role object "the parents' evening"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be"
      role subject ?x
      role object "Zsófia Kovács"
      polarity negated
    end
  end

@q5 query
  select ?l
  where match
    relation "fly to"
    role subject "Emma"
    role destination ?l
    polarity affirmed
  end
